title: Desert Nomad Sandboarding Cinematic
scene_description: Third-person cinematic view of a desert nomad sandboarding at high speed down towering golden sand dunes shaped like natural half-pipes, surrounded by distant ancient ruins under a massive glowing sunset. Heat shimmer ripples through the air as dust clouds trail behind the rider.

subject.action: Sandboarding downhill with aggressive carving turns
subject.wardrobe: Flowing desert garments with long fabric strips fluttering violently in the wind

environment.location: Vast desert with towering golden dunes and scattered ancient ruins
environment.atmosphere: Warm color grading, atmospheric haze, visible heat shimmer, airborne sand particles

camera.movement: Sweeping cinematic tracking, dynamic descent following the rider
camera.effects: Motion blur, depth of field, dynamic framing
camera.speed_emphasis: Dust wake trailing behind, sand sprays during sharp turns
